newsitem.title: USA: Apple cuts prices on some computers.
newsitem.headline: Apple cuts prices on some computers.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc is cutting prices by as much as $300 on certain Power Macintosh 6500 and Macintosh Performa 6400 series computers.
In a statement issued Saturday, Apple said the move is part of its strategy to provide powerful, easy-to-use computers at competitive prices.

Prices on the Power Mac 6500 series now range from $1,800 up to $2,800, depending on the model. The old price range was $2,000 to $3,000. The Performa 6400 computers now range from $1,400 to $1,800 vs. a previous $1,700 to $2,100, depending on the model.

The price cuts come after the ouster last week of Gilbert Amelio as head of Cupertino, Calif.-based Apple, which has seen its share of the market for personal computers shrink to 3.3 percent. The market is dominated by PCs based on Intel computer chips and running Microsoft Corp.'s Windows operating systems.
